title: Moving a song to another key
summary: Keep the numbers, change the key.

steps.title: Transpose
steps.body:
To **transpose** a song is to move it to a different key. With numbers it is easy: keep the numbers and play them in the new key. I–V–vi–IV in C is C G Am F; transposed to G it is G D Em C.

**Why it matters:** Singers ask for songs in the key that suits their voice. If you think in numbers, you can transpose on the spot.

steps.title: Same numbers, new key
steps.body: I–IV–V in D major: D, G, A.

items.prompt: Now transpose it: play I–IV–V–I in D.

steps.title: Move a song
steps.body: Take a song you play by ear, work out its numbers, then play it in a key a whole step higher.

items.prompt: In A major, which chord is the IV?
Transpose 1–5–6–4 to E: play it in E.
Transpose ii–V–I to D: play it in D.
